steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Timber working: tenon saw (straight cuts), coping saw (curves), chisel (paring and mortising), plane (flat surfaces), file/sandpaper (smooth finish). Jointing: PVA glue, screws, dowels, dovetails, mortise-and-tenon. | Key Fact: Metal working: hacksaw (cutting bar/flat stock), pillar drill (accurate holes), file (shaping and deburring), sheet metal snips (cutting thin sheet), tap and die (internal/external threads). Joining: soldering, brazing, welding, rivets, nuts and bolts. | Key Fact: Polymer working: laser cutter (2D profiles from sheet acrylic/MDF), line bender (folds acrylic along a heated element), strip heater, drill (slow speed to avoid melting). Joining: acrylic cement (capillary action), solvent weld (PVC), ultrasonic welding, snap-fit joints. | Key Fact: Workshop safe
